name: toolkit-mcp-server
description: Fast developer utilities — random ID generation, QR codes, IP geolocation, hashing, and encoding — plus gated, fail-closed network and system diagnostics.

interface.shortDescription: Random IDs, QR codes, IP geolocation, hashing, and encoding utilities.
interface.longDescription: A grab-bag of fast developer utilities: cryptographically-random ID generation (UUIDv4/v7, ULID), QR code generation (SVG/PNG/terminal), IP geolocation, cryptographic hashing with constant-time compare, and base64/hex/URL encoding. Two host-probing tools (network diagnostics and system info) are gated off by default, fail-closed, so a hosted instance carries no SSRF or info-disclosure surface.
